Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Anna advised Nina to try swimming as a new hobby. At first, Nina found it difficult to keep the habit. Best of all, there was a surge in demand for masks.

Nina ordered dumplings and coffee at the science lab last night. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Also, she is good at art and music.
